points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 罗贯中出生于山西太原一个书香门第，自幼受到良好的教育。他天资聪颖，博览群书，尤其对历史典籍和民间故事有着浓厚兴趣。这一时期，他广泛阅读了《史记》《汉书》等史书，以及各种民间传说和话本，为他后来的创作奠定了坚实的基础。太原作为北方文化重镇，多元的文化氛围开阔了他的视野，培养了他对历史人物和事件的独特理解。
points.descriptionEn: Luo Guanzhong was born into a scholarly family in Taiyuan, Shanxi, where he received excellent education from an early age. He was naturally intelligent and extensively read, showing particular interest in historical classics and folk tales. During this period, he read widely from historical works like 'Records of the Grand Historian' and 'Book of Han', as well as various folk legends and vernacular stories, laying a solid foundation for his later literary career. Taiyuan, as a cultural center in northern China, provided a diverse cultural atmosphere that broadened his horizons and cultivated his unique understanding of historical figures and events.

points.title: 游历江南
points.description: 青年时期的罗贯中离开家乡，游历江南地区，特别是南宋故都杭州。在这期间，他深入接触了江南地区的文化传统，特别是宋元以来的话本艺术和戏曲表演。杭州作为当时的文化中心，汇集了各地的说书艺人，罗贯中在此学习了民间说唱艺术，收集了大量三国故事素材。这段经历极大地丰富了他的创作素材，也使他形成了将历史与民间传说相结合的独特创作风格。
points.descriptionEn: In his youth, Luo Guanzhong left his hometown and traveled through the Jiangnan region, particularly Hangzhou, the former capital of the Southern Song Dynasty. During this period, he deeply engaged with the cultural traditions of Jiangnan, especially the vernacular storytelling and theatrical performances of the Song and Yuan dynasties. As a cultural center, Hangzhou gathered storytellers from various regions, where Luo Guanzhong learned folk storytelling arts and collected extensive materials about the Three Kingdoms stories. This experience greatly enriched his creative materials and helped him form a unique writing style that combined history with folk legends.

points.title: 元末乱世
points.description: 元朝末年，罗贯中来到元大都（今北京），正值元朝统治摇摇欲坠、农民起义风起云涌之际。他亲身经历了元朝末年的社会动荡和政治腐败，目睹了各种社会矛盾和民族冲突。这段经历使他深刻认识到历史兴衰的规律，也为他创作《三国演义》提供了丰富的历史素材和思想启示。在大都期间，他开始系统整理三国历史资料，并构思小说框架，将历史真实与艺术想象相结合，为后来的创作奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: At the end of the Yuan Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong came to Yuan Dadu (modern Beijing), a time when the Yuan rule was collapsing and peasant uprisings were erupting everywhere. He personally experienced the social turmoil and political corruption of the late Yuan period, witnessing various social contradictions and ethnic conflicts. This experience gave him a profound understanding of the patterns of historical rise and fall, providing rich historical materials and ideological inspiration for his later creation of 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'. During his time in Dadu, he began systematically organizing historical materials about the Three Kingdoms and构思 the framework of the novel, combining historical truth with artistic imagination.

points.title: 明初创作
points.description: 明朝建立后，罗贯中移居苏州。这一时期，他开始专注于文学创作，完成了《三国演义》的初稿。苏州作为江南文化中心，文人荟萃，为罗贯中的创作提供了良好的环境。他在苏州期间，不仅完成了《三国演义》的创作，还开始创作其他历史小说，如《隋唐志传》等。这一时期，他的创作风格逐渐成熟，形成了将历史真实与艺术想象相结合的独特手法，对后世历史小说创作产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: After the establishment of the Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong moved to Suzhou. During this period, he focused on literary creation and completed the first draft of 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'. As a cultural center in Jiangnan, Suzhou gathered numerous literati, providing an excellent environment for Luo Guanzhong's creative work. In Suzhou, he not only completed 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' but also began writing other historical novels such as 'Tang-Shi Zhizhuan'. During this time, his writing style gradually matured, forming a unique approach that combined historical truth with artistic imagination, exerting a profound influence on later historical novel writing.

points.title: 晚年著述
points.description: 晚年，罗贯中移居福建建阳，继续文学创作和修订工作。建阳是当时重要的印刷出版中心，为他的作品传播提供了便利。在这一时期，他完成了《三国演义》的最终修订，并创作了《残唐五代史演义传》等作品。罗贯中在建阳度过了他的晚年，将毕生对历史的思考和对人性的洞察融入作品中。他的作品通过建阳的印刷业广泛流传，影响深远，成为中国文学史上的经典之作。他的创作不仅丰富了历史小说的体裁，也为后世提供了了解三国历史的重要窗口。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Luo Guanzhong moved to Jianyang, Fujian, where he continued his literary creation and revision work. Jianyang was an important printing and publishing center at the time, facilitating the dissemination of his works. During this period, he completed the final revision of 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' and created other works such as 'The Romance of the Late Tang and Five Dynasties'. Luo Guanzhong spent his final years in Jianyang, incorporating his lifelong reflections on history and insights into human nature into his works. His works spread widely through Jianyang's printing industry, exerting profound influence and becoming classics in Chinese literary history. His creation not only enriched the genre of historical novels but also provided an important window for later generations to understand the history of the Three Kingdoms.

supporter.zh: 罗贯中被誉为中国历史小说的奠基人，其《三国演义》开创了中国章回体历史小说的先河。他通过生动的笔触塑造了众多栩栩如生的历史人物形象，如诸葛亮、关羽、曹操等，成为中国文学史上的经典形象。罗贯中的作品不仅具有极高的文学价值，更蕴含着深刻的历史智慧和人生哲理，对后世文学创作产生了深远影响。他善于将历史真实与艺术想象相结合，使枯燥的历史变得生动有趣，为中国传统文化的传承做出了重要贡献。
supporter.en: Luo Guanzhong is revered as the founder of Chinese historical novels, with 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' pioneering the Chinese vernacular historical novel form. Through vivid writing, he created numerous lifelike historical figures such as Zhuge Liang, Guan Yu, and Cao Cao, who have become classic figures in Chinese literary history. His works possess not only high literary value but also profound historical wisdom and life philosophy, exerting far-reaching influence on later literary creation. He excelled at combining historical truth with artistic imagination, making dry history come alive and making significant contributions to the inheritance of traditional Chinese culture.

critic.zh: 批评者认为罗贯中的历史小说存在严重的史实歪曲问题，尤其是《三国演义》中大量虚构情节与历史事实不符。他为了艺术效果而夸大某些人物形象，如神化诸葛亮，丑化曹操，这种历史观缺乏客观性。此外，作品中的封建忠君思想和男尊女卑观念也受到现代价值观的质疑。罗贯中的创作虽然文学成就高，但在历史真实性方面存在明显缺陷，容易误导读者对历史的认知，这种历史与文学的混淆也成为中国传统历史小说的普遍问题。
critic.en: Critics argue that Luo Guanzhong's historical novels contain serious distortions of historical facts, particularly in 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' where numerous fictionalized elements deviate from historical reality. For artistic effect, he exaggerated certain character portrayals, such as deifying Zhuge Liang and demonizing Cao Cao, reflecting a historical perspective lacking objectivity. Additionally, feudal loyalty to the monarch and patriarchal values in his works are questioned from modern perspectives. While Luo Guanzhong's literary achievements are high, his works have clear deficiencies in historical authenticity, potentially misleading readers' understanding of history. This confusion between history and literature has become a common problem in traditional Chinese historical novels.

objective.zh: 从历史学和流行文化视角看，罗贯中及其作品已成为中国文化的重要符号。《三国演义》不仅是一部文学作品，更是中国人集体记忆和文化认同的重要组成部分，影响了数代中国人的历史观和价值观。在流行文化中，三国故事通过戏曲、影视、游戏等多种形式广泛传播，罗贯中塑造的人物形象已成为文化原型。学术界认为，罗贯中的创作体现了中国传统文人的历史观和价值观，反映了儒家思想对中国文学的影响。他的作品既是文学经典，也是研究中国古代历史观和文学传统的重要文本。
objective.en: From historical and popular culture perspectives, Luo Guanzhong and his works have become important symbols of Chinese culture. 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' is not merely a literary work but an integral part of Chinese collective memory and cultural identity, influencing the historical perspectives and values of generations of Chinese people. In popular culture, Three Kingdoms stories have widely spread through various forms such as opera, film, and television, with character images created by Luo Guanzhong becoming cultural archetypes. Academia views Luo Guanzhong's creation as embodying traditional Chinese literati's historical perspectives and values, reflecting the influence of Confucian thought on Chinese literature. His works are both literary classics and important texts for studying ancient Chinese historical perspectives and literary traditions.

self.zh: 话说天下大势，分久必合，合久必分。
self.en: As the saying goes, after long division, there must be unification; after long unification, there must be division.

others.zh: 罗贯中的《三国演义》是一部伟大的历史小说，它不仅讲述了一个精彩的故事，更展现了中国人的智慧和价值观。
others.en: Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' is a great historical novel that not only tells a wonderful story but also displays the wisdom and values of the Chinese people.
